post.description:
Confirms a one-time code against the authenticated student's **primary** phone number and marks it verified.

The number is resolved server-side from the authenticated user, so a code can never be applied to another account's phone; `phone`, `phone_id` and `e164_number` in the body are stripped and ignored.

Verification grants **no additional access** — it only flips `phone_verified` on the profile. If the number is already verified the call succeeds without consuming a code.

Each code allows a limited number of attempts (default 5). Every submission, right or wrong, consumes one. Once the allowance is spent the code is burned and a new one must be requested.

Changing the phone number through `POST /public/profile` resets it to pending and expires any outstanding code, so a code issued for the old number cannot verify the new one.

code.description: The numeric code delivered by SMS. 4–10 digits.

200.description: The number is verified. `data.user` is the refreshed profile with `phone_verified: true`.

401.description: No valid bearer token was supplied.

422.description: Wrong code (`PHONE_OTP_INVALID`), the code has expired (`PHONE_OTP_EXPIRED`), no code is outstanding (`PHONE_OTP_NOT_FOUND`), no phone is on record (`PHONE_NOT_FOUND`), or `code` failed validation.

429.description: The attempt allowance for this code is spent. Request a new code.

message.const: Maximum verification attempts exceeded. Please request a new code.

503.description: The verification provider could not be reached. The upstream message is logged, never returned.

message.const: We could not send a verification code right now. Please try again shortly.

post.description:
Sends a one-time verification code to the authenticated student's **primary** phone number via Twilio Verify.

The number is always resolved server-side from the authenticated user; any `phone`, `phone_id` or `e164_number` in the body is stripped and ignored.

Phone verification is **optional**. Nothing on the platform — registration, login, profile updates, studying, quizzes, fellowships or AI chat — is gated on a verified phone number. This endpoint exists only so a student who wants a verified number can obtain one.

Issuing a code expires any previous pending code for the same number. If the number is already verified the call succeeds without sending anything.

**Limits** — a resend cooldown (default 60s) and an hourly allowance (default 5), both scoped to the phone number, purpose and client IP, on top of a coarse `throttle:10,1` route limit. A failed delivery does not consume the allowance.

Upstream provider errors are never surfaced verbatim; they are logged and replaced by a generic `PHONE_OTP_SEND_FAILED`.

channel.description: Optional delivery channel. Defaults to `phone.default_channel` (sms). Must be one of `phone.supported_channels`.

200.description: Code sent, or the number was already verified.

message.example: We have sent a verification code to your phone number.

message.const: This phone number is already verified.

401.description: No valid bearer token was supplied.

422.description: No phone number on record (`PHONE_NOT_FOUND`), or the requested channel is not supported (validation error on `channel`).

message.example: No phone number is on record for this account. Please add one first.

429.description: Resend cooldown still active (`PHONE_OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN`) or the hourly allowance is spent (`PHONE_OTP_SEND_LIMIT_REACHED`). The coarse route throttle may also answer here without a `code`.

message.example: Please wait 42 seconds before requesting another verification code.

503.description: The verification provider could not be reached. The upstream message is logged, never returned.

message.const: We could not send a verification code right now. Please try again shortly.

is_email_verified.description: Retained for the existing contract; same value as `email_verified`.

phone.description: E.164 form of the student's primary phone number, or null when none is on record.

phone_verified.description: Whether the number reported in `phone` is verified. False when no phone exists. Read-only: it is derived from the phone's own status and can never be set through a request.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
